description: 外部验证 tracker import package 契约。该包消费 external validation issue export，生成独立 issue body 文件、导入 manifest 和人工可复核的 tracker CLI 命令清单。该包不创建真实 issue、不请求网络、不执行 gh、不保存凭证或 endpoint、不把 package ready 等同于 issue created 或 live passed。

executionPolicy.packageGate: blocked until an operator reviews the package, creates tracker issues, executes real external validations, and proof-ref/live-proof gates accept redacted evidence.
executionPolicy.noNetwork: This generator must not call GitHub, gh, production API, HF Space, Telegram Bot, Postgres, OTel, IdP, SIEM, Vault, developer portal or third-party audit services.
executionPolicy.redaction: Output may contain issue titles, labels, owner/category ids, work item ids, occurrence ids, credential variable names, command templates, body file paths and hashes only; it must not contain endpoint URLs, credential values, DSNs, webhook secrets, chat ids, payloads, user inputs or production logs.
executionPolicy.sourceBinding: Output must bind to issue export sha256, issue export kind and current commit.

trackerPolicy.allowedUse: Operator may review issue body files and command text, then manually run or import them in an approved tracker session.

privacyBoundary: Tracker import package 只保存 issue body markdown、body file path、title、label、owner/category/workItemId、required credential 名称、脱敏命令文本、hash 和关闭条件；不得保存真实 URL、token、secret、DSN、webhook secret、chat id、外部账号、生产日志、trace payload、报告正文或用户输入。
nonClaims: Does not create issues in GitHub or any external tracker.
Does not execute gh or tracker CLI commands.
Does not execute external live checks.
Does not prove any external live validation has passed.
Does not create accepted proof refs by itself.
Does not mean FateCat is 100% production infrastructure.
